    Adding arrows to a simply connected ray category #

    Let B = A/⟨S⟩ be the quotient of a ray category by the ideal generated by a set S of arrows. If every cocycle on B is a coboundary and every arrow e of S satisfies a nonzero relation e uₑ = u with paths uₑ, u avoiding S, then every cocycle on A is a coboundary (isCoboundary_of_step): a cocycle on A restricts to one on B, whose potential also fits the arrows of S by the relations. This is the simple-connectivity step of the stages in Fischbacher's Satz 5.1.
